issues.title: feat(mods): support callback-only native mods before game hook points
issues.author: momo1212221
issues.body:
Goal
Make native callback-only mods an explicitly supported and tested path for games that have no game-specific hook points yet, starting with RAC2.
This is intentionally smaller than adding RAC2 hook points.
Current behavior found on develop
The native mod loader already appears generic:

mods::plan checks game/disc, API version, platform library and dependencies, but does not require a game to expose hook points.
